place.zh: 沉鼎观 · 柴房 · 雪夜
place.en: Chending Temple · The woodshed · A snowy night

setup.zh: 头场雪下了一夜。大通铺上鼾声连成一片，你摸进柴房，闩上门，从储物袋里摸出那个油纸包，把那三颗九转倒在柴墩上。
setup.en: The first snow falls all night. With the dormitory snoring as one, you slip into the woodshed, bar the door, take the oilpaper packet out of the storage pouch and tip the three nine-turn pills onto the chopping block.

recap.zh: 雪夜，你对着那三颗九转算账：宗门那一颗在祁长松手里，九转说不清来历。一颗你贴肉揣着，跟木牌挨在一处；两颗收回储物袋。说得清来历的那一颗，全观一年一颗——总有一年。过了两夜，你把赤铜葫芦和盾片喂了饭桶，它吐出一口剑，你管它叫劈柴。
recap.en: On a snowy night you did your sums over the three nine-turn pills: the sect's one was in Qi Changsong's hands, and a nine-turn pill has no history you can tell. One you carried against your skin, beside the token; two went back into the storage pouch. The one with a history you can tell — the whole temple gets one a year. Some year. Two nights later you fed the red-copper gourd and the shield shards to the Rice Tub, and it spat out a sword; you called it Kindling.

zh: 头场雪。柴房里，半根蜡烛。
吃的是哪一颗？这一问，拿什么答？
en: The first snow. Half a candle in the woodshed.
Three nine-turn pills, nine gold rings each.
Which one did you eat? What answer will you give?

story.zh:
拜过了师，外头下起雪来。那是那一年的头场雪，下得又密又静，一夜之间，把沉鼎山的三百级石阶埋得只剩一道白坡。

小满寻了个夜里，等大通铺上鼾声连成了一片，悄悄起身，摸到后头柴房，闩上门，点起那半根蜡烛，从储物袋里摸出那个油纸包，把那三颗九转倒在柴墩上，对着它们坐了半晌。

他是在算账。宗门那一颗，在祁长松手里，祁长松这时候正闭着关。他手里这三颗，九道金纹，透亮得像三滴凝住的露水，一颗比全观那一颗强了不知多少倍——可九转说不清来历。将来他筑基，周衡的账上要记一笔，师父要问一句，全观的眼睛都要看：吃的是哪一颗？这一问，他拿什么答？
story.en:
Once he had bowed to his master, the snow began. It was that year's first snow, thick and silent, and in a single night it buried the three hundred steps of Mount Chending until only a white slope was left.

Xiaoman picked a night, waited until the snoring on the long bunk ran together into one, got up quietly, felt his way to the woodshed at the back, barred the door, lit the half candle, took the oilpaper packet out of the storage pouch, tipped the three nine-turn pills onto the chopping block, and sat looking at them for a long while.

He was doing his sums. The sect's pill was in Qi Changsong's hands, and Qi Changsong was in seclusion. These three in his own hands, nine gold rings each, clear as three drops of frozen dew, were each better than the whole temple's one by who knew how much — but a nine-turn pill has no history he could tell. When he came to lay his Foundation, Zhou Heng's ledger would want a line, his master would ask a question, and the whole temple's eyes would look: which one did you eat? What answer would he give?

label.zh: 一颗贴肉揣着，两颗收回储物袋
label.en: One against your skin; two back in the storage pouch

exits.means: keeps one nine-turn Foundation pill against his skin beside the token and puts the other two back in the storage pouch; waits for the year he can win the sect's; two nights on, feeds the red-copper gourd and the shield shards to the Rice Tub and gets a plain sword, Kindling

story.zh:
那三颗九转，他当下打定了主意：一颗，是自己的；一颗，留着救命；还有一颗，先留着。那两颗仍用油纸裹了三层，收回储物袋里。筑基丹是给九层大圆满的人破关用的，他才练气四层，吃不得。自己那一颗另拿油纸包了，贴肉揣着，跟那块木牌挨在一处，一个凉，一个暖。木牌背面那道裂纹，是秘境里破那面盾裂的，隔着油纸也摸得出来。她醒是醒了，话却比从前少。至于说得清来历的那一颗——全观一年一颗，年年腊八摆在五行台上。他吹了蜡烛，在黑地里想：总有一年。

剑诀拿到了手，剑却没有。瞿老教剑，拿的是扫帚把；他总不能也拿一根扫帚把。

过了两夜，他又摸进柴房，从储物袋里倒出两样东西：邹青松那只赤铜葫芦，塞子还塞着，肚里空空的；那七八瓣赤铜盾片，叮叮当当一小堆。赤松观的东西，山上亮不得，留着，是一条人命挂在腰上；葫芦里那口火，他喂了一个月，喂进去一缕，漏出来半缕——他自己五扇门里就有一扇火，用不着它。

他拿袖子把饭桶擦了一遍，按到第三回，盖子开了。他先把盾片一片一片丢进去，末了丢进葫芦，两只手按上铜肚子：「给我一口剑。不要好看的，要砍得动的。」

饭桶嚼了很久。「咯嘣」，「咯嘣」，嚼那只葫芦，嚼得比嚼哪一样都费劲，嚼一阵，歇一歇，像一个没牙的老头啃一块冻硬了的饼；歇一回，吸他一口气，吸到第五口，他眼前一阵一阵发黑。末了，盖子「咔哒」一声弹开，一道红光窜出来，「笃」的一声，钉在了柴房的门板上，剑柄还在嗡嗡地颤。小狰吓得一头扎进了柴堆。

小满拔了三回，才拔下来。一口剑，三尺来长，剑身暗红，是那葫芦和盾片的铜色，火纹一道也没有了；剑脊上一溜锤印，坑坑洼洼，像镇上铁匠铺里学徒打坏了的。他灌一丝气进去，剑身上浮起一层淡淡的光，薄得像一层油——是件法器，最寻常的那一种。他拿它劈了一根柴，柴应声两半，切口齐得像拿尺子比过。

木牌一烫，银月钻了出来，绕着那口剑看了一圈，懒懒地道：「起个名字。剑要有名字。本王给你想一个——」小满又劈了一根：「劈柴。」银月的胡子翘了一翘：「……那是名字？」小满道：「它头一件干的，就是这个。」他把剑往柴堆上一插，又去捡第三根。

赤松观的东西，从此一样也不剩了。
story.en:
About the three nine-turn pills he made up his mind on the spot: one was his own; one to save a life; and one, kept for now. Those two he wrapped again in three layers of oilpaper and put back in the storage pouch. A Foundation pill is for someone at layer nine, great perfection, to break through; he was at Qi Refining layer four, and couldn't take it. His own he wrapped in oilpaper separately and carried against his skin, next to the wooden token, one cool, one warm. The crack across the back of the token, from breaking that shield in the hidden realm, he could feel even through the oilpaper. She was awake, but she said less than before. As for a pill whose history he could tell — the whole temple got one a year, set out on the Five Elements Platform every Laba. He blew out the candle and thought in the dark: some year.

He had the sword canon now, but no sword. Old Qu taught the sword with a broom handle; he could hardly take up a broom handle too.

Two nights later he slipped into the woodshed again and tipped two things out of the storage pouch: Zou Qingsong's red-copper gourd, cork still in, nothing in its belly; and the seven or eight shards of the red-copper shield, a little clinking heap. Red Pine things could not be shown on the mountain, and to keep them was to wear a man's life at his waist; and the fire in the gourd — he had fed it for a month, a wisp in, half a wisp leaking out — he had a fire door of his own among his five, and no need of it.

He wiped the Rice Tub over with his sleeve and pressed; on the third press the lid opened. In went the shards, one by one, and last of all the gourd; then both his hands on the bronze belly: "Give me a sword. Not a pretty one. One that cuts."

The Rice Tub chewed a long time. *Crunch*, *crunch* — the gourd it chewed harder than anything yet, chewing a while and resting, like a toothless old man at a frozen flatbread; every rest it took a mouthful of his qi, and by the fifth his sight was going black in waves. At last the lid sprang open with a *clack*, a streak of red shot out — *thock* — and stuck in the woodshed door, the hilt still humming. Little Zheng dived headfirst into the woodpile.

It took Xiaoman three pulls to work it loose. A sword, three feet or so, its blade a dull red — the copper of the gourd and the shards — with not one line of the fire pattern left; down the spine a row of hammer marks, pitted and uneven, like a botched piece from an apprentice at the town smithy. He sent a thread of qi into it, and a faint light rose on the blade, thin as a film of oil — an artifact, of the commonest kind. He split a log with it: the log fell in two, the cut as straight as if ruled.

The token burned; Yinyue slipped out, walked once round the sword, and said lazily: "Give it a name. A sword wants a name. This king will think of one —" Xiaoman split another log. "Kindling." Her whiskers twitched up. "…That's a name?" "It's the first thing it did," said Xiaoman. He stuck the sword in the woodpile and went for a third log.

Of Red Pine's things, from that night, not one was left.

exits.means: eats a nine-turn Foundation pill now

text.zh: 筑基丹是给九层大圆满的人破关用的。你才练气四层，吃不得。你把手缩了回来。
text.en: A Foundation pill is for breaking through at layer nine, great perfection. You are at layer four of Qi Refining; you can't take it. You pull your hand back.
